faq.q: When does the race start, and at what time?
faq.k: 1 november sunday time start date when
faq.e: The race starts on Sunday 1 November 2026 at 1:02 pm, off Saint-Malo, with 118 skippers on the start line.

faq.q: How can I watch the start, and from where?
faq.k: watch the start watch live youtube television france 3 giant screen fan zone cap fréhel pointe du grouin natura 2000
faq.e: There are several ways to enjoy it: on the giant screens of the fan zone, at the village; live on the Route du Rhum's official YouTube channel; on the official website,…

faq.q: How many skippers take the start?
faq.k: how many skippers sailors entrants rookies women
faq.e: 118 skippers on a single start line, across six classes. The skippers page lets you sort them: first-timers, women, former winners, skippers from the Saint-Malo area or from…

faq.q: When is the village open, and at what times?
faq.k: 20 october opening hours opening closing days time late night evening midnight exhibitors party bar
faq.e: The village is open from Tuesday 20 October to Sunday 1 November: thirteen days of celebration over 70,000 m² around the harbour basins. Exhibitors open at 10 am (at noon on the…

faq.q: Is entry free? Do I need a ticket or a pass?
faq.k: free price cost ticket pass paid book booking bag check bags security
faq.e: Yes, entry is 100% free, with no ticket: no pass or booking needed, and the village is open to everyone. There will be systematic bag checks at the entrance.

faq.q: Can I see the boats and go on the pontoons?
faq.k: pontoon basin on board visit see the boats skippers signing meet
faq.e: The boats of all six classes are moored in the basins, at the heart of the village, class by class. The interactive map, which will show where each of them is, will be available…

faq.q: What is there to see and do at the village?
faq.k: activities stage big wheel zip line concert food eat what to do
faq.e: The whole fleet in the basins, two stages (Saint-Vincent and the Écluse stands), a big wheel, a zip line, the Art Explora museum boat and food areas. Every event, day by day, is…

faq.q: Where can I find the village map and the programme?
faq.k: map plan programme pdf entrances where is
faq.e: The village map can be downloaded as a PDF from the village page. Its interactive version, with the entrances, events and boats, will be available soon. Every event, day by day,…

faq.q: How do I get to the village without a car?
faq.k: bus bike on foot train shuttle car sharing access transport
faq.e: By bus, Saint-Malo's network costs €1.40 online or at a sales point, €2 on board. By bike, secure bike parks are waiting at every entrance to the village, and shared e-bikes are…

faq.q: Where can I park, and is parking paid?
faq.k: parking car park park car paid charging charging point camper van
faq.e: Traffic is restricted during the event, car parks are not right next to the entrances, and public parking is paid. The 2026 traffic plan, prices, charging points and closed…

faq.q: Is the village accessible to people with disabilities?
faq.k: reduced mobility disability wheelchair accessible shuttle reserved spaces priority lane
faq.e: Yes: the whole village is accessible to people with reduced mobility and people with disabilities, with dedicated arrangements: special shuttles to and from car parks, and…

faq.q: Are there specific arrangements for people with disabilities?
faq.k: quiet space quiet hour calm noise sign language sensitive autism
faq.e: Quiet spaces, at the heart of the village, for people with disabilities or who are sensitive to noise. A quiet hour, every day from 21 to 31 October from 12:30 to 1:30 pm: a…

faq.q: Are dogs allowed at the village?
faq.k: dog dogs pet pets assistance dog guide dog
faq.e: We love our four-legged friends 🐾, but for everyone's safety and comfort, dogs are not allowed at the village. Only assistance dogs accompanying a person with a disability are…

faq.q: Can I bring a pushchair?
faq.k: pushchair stroller pram baby children family
faq.e: Yes, pushchairs can get everywhere in the village.

faq.q: Why the emphasis on public transport and cycling?
faq.k: environment carbon emissions ademe ecology footprint
faq.e: Because 64.4% of the event's emissions come from spectators travelling to the start village (ADEME figures, one way). Train, bus, bike or car sharing are the most direct way to…

faq.q: What is the Route du Rhum course?
faq.k: course route miles distance pointe-à-pitre guadeloupe transatlantic atlantic azores
faq.e: A solo transatlantic race from Saint-Malo to Pointe-à-Pitre: about 3,542 nautical miles, or 6,560 km. The fleet crosses the Channel, rounds Ushant, heads down into the Bay of…

faq.q: What kinds of boats take part?
faq.k: classes ultim imoca class40 ocean fifty vintage monohull multihull
faq.e: Six classes start together: Ultim, Ocean Fifty, IMOCA, Class40, and two new classes in 2026, Vintage Mono and Vintage Multi, which replace the former Rhum categories and bring…

faq.q: How long does the race last, and what is the record?
faq.k: duration record days finish how long caudrelier winner
faq.e: The record belongs to Charles Caudrelier, winner in 2022: 6 days 19 hours 47 minutes and 25 seconds aboard the Ultim Maxi Edmond de Rothschild. The smallest boats take several…

faq.q: Why does the race take place every four years?
faq.k: four years 1978 history edition etevenon legend
faq.e: Created in 1978 by Michel Etevenon, the Route du Rhum is sailed every four years: that is how long skippers need to put a project together, and what makes each edition a rare…

faq.q: Do professionals and amateurs really start together?
faq.k: amateurs professionals pros women men same line
faq.e: Yes. The race brings together professionals and amateurs, women and men, on the same start line, something rare in top-level sport. In 2022, 138 skippers started and 103 made it…

faq.q: Can I enter the race?
faq.k: take part entry register skipper race 2030 vintage transat cic english transat
faq.e: For 2026, it is too late: the next edition will take place in 2030. However, another legendary race is opening its doors to the Vintage classes: The Transat CIC, formerly the…

faq.q: Where and when do the boats arrive?
faq.k: finish arrival guadeloupe pointe-à-pitre mémorial acte macte 5 november when
faq.e: Finishes are celebrated at the Mémorial ACTe, in Pointe-à-Pitre, which has welcomed every skipper since 2018, from the first to the last. The first boats are expected from 5…

faq.q: Are there villages in Guadeloupe?
faq.k: village guadeloupe bas du fort basse-terre celebration weeks
faq.e: Yes, three: at the Mémorial ACTe, at the Bas-du-Fort marina and in Basse-Terre, for three weeks of celebration.

faq.q: How do I get to the Mémorial ACTe?
faq.k: macte getting there airport taxi darboussier address pointe-à-pitre
faq.e: The Mémorial ACTe is on rue Raspail, on the Darboussier site, in Pointe-à-Pitre. Allow 10 to 15 minutes on foot from the place de la Victoire or the port; Pôle Caraïbes airport…

faq.q: How do I apply for a press or photo accreditation?
faq.k: accreditation press journalist photographer media content creator badge
faq.e: Pre-applications are open until 15 October 2026, only through the official form: no application sent by email will be processed. One application per person, linked to an active…

faq.q: Where can I buy the poster and official merchandise?
faq.k: shop poster t-shirt goodies order merchandise licence souvenir
faq.e: On the official shop, and from the makers of official licensed products: posters, postcards, ponchos, wooden boats… Their catalogue can be downloaded from the dedicated page.

faq.q: What is My Espace Rhum for?
faq.k: espace rhum account log in points badges game competition sign up
faq.e: It is your personal space: follow your favourite skippers, get personalised content, take on challenges, enter exclusive competitions and collect badges as the race unfolds.

faq.q: Where can I meet TyMAL, the mascot?
faq.k: tymal mascot tour puffin where is
faq.e: TyMAL is on tour before the start, in Brittany and beyond: the tour map shows the next stops, and tells you whether TyMAL is coming near you. During the village, TyMAL is there…

faq.q: Is there an educational kit for schools?
